title: God's divine council in Genesis: 'Behold, man has become like us'

tellings.quote: he turns to this divine council, this mysterious council full of other beings in heaven. That's way very much often overlooked. And he says, "Behold, man has become like us."

plain: In the Bible's book of Genesis, after the events in the Garden of Eden, God turns to a mysterious council of other beings in heaven and says, "Behold, man has become like us." The researcher Luke Caverns reads this from the text himself and says this divine council is very often overlooked. He points to it because it would suggest the Bible describes other heavenly beings alongside God.
